column1: # DARK SOULS: REMASTERED on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# FromSoftware's engine on SDK 4.5.0, update 1.0.3; 3,099 shaders, all translated. patches.py runs it at 60 fps (30 on the Switch); its note: ladders misplay at 60.
# Tested 2026-11-06 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), docked: the title, the offline notice, the first-start settings (brightness,
# options, buttons), character creation (the name through the overlay keyboard), the opening movie (skipped with +), the Undead Asylum's first cell; a save and Continue.
# The menus confirm with B and go back with A (the game's own prompts), and take short presses: a press of 0.3 s or more repeats in its lists.
# Fixed on the way (core): more than 4,096 memory pools (FATAL "too many memory pools" within 3 s of boot); the scene's bindless textures bound the dummy sampler.
# Open: the Asylum's upper walls, pillars and floors are drawn as streaks (stretched texels) while other surfaces (the lower brick walls, the gates, the character) are
# right. Not the multisample resolve (the resolved target shows the same), not the textures (a 32x2048 BC1 one dumps whole), not the sampler (real wrap modes now), not the
# integer texture coordinates (RG16I / RGBA16I, now declared integer inputs). Frame rate 40-60 in the cell. The ladder at 60 fps not checked.
